title: [COM3D2] Custom Order Maid 3D2 Modpack R4
description:
![Modpack R4](https://i.imgur.com/MhcILBU.png)
## This is old. Get updated version.

Before you download you need to know that this is not a repack of Custom Order Maid 3D2. It does not include the actual game. The modpack is only a piece for building the “ULTIMATE” version of the game.
At the time of upload, the modpack was initially tested with COM3D2 update 1.55.x. It will work fine with newer 2.x.x - 3.x.x updates too as long as you keep the plugins updated using the latest COM Modular Installer.

This is an addon for the Japanese version of the game and requires both COM3D2 and the older CM3D2 with all their DLC to be fully compatible. The final download size roughly sums up to 190GB+
Don't go crying to Discord for help if you cheaped out on storage and didn't even bother to read the documentation. 
Take your time. Install everything properly and you won't have any issues.
The modpack has no duplicates and no game breaking errors or missing files. I'm not responsible for errors caused by plugins that may break in the near future due to game updates but I will put warnings if needed.
Using some mods might not be as straight forward as you think so maybe reading the FAQ or translating the mod's readme could help.

I made a comprehensive guide to help you install and use this pack. Hopefully it will answer all your questions and clear any confusion.
Read it at https://pastebin.com/1SFajwy5

It took me months of searching, testing, fixing and tweaking to get it to this point.
I made this pack so you can enjoy the full game experince while not having to deal with the headache of looking for mods and getting them to work. It has a bit of everything but it can't possibly satisfy everyone. 
If you don't like it, don't use it.

COM3D2 Modpack is a collection of clothing and body parts that were fully tested and optimized to work without issues within the modpack environment. 
I tried to keep it as generic as possible so I only included normal clothing mods or items that are rare or unique in a way that would make up for an interesting addition to the customizing experience. It is not feasable to include too many character specific mods because the download size would skyrocket.

The modpack includes various uncensor skins and body replacements. You must choose between Mod\ [CMI] Uncensors or  Mod\BODY\UNCENSOR. You can't have both or there will be conflicts. 
Translation is a separate optional module and is linked in the guide. The translation is ported from the complete COM3D2 English Vanilla Repack. Newer Japanese DLC events will still be machine translated. 

The modpack was designed to work with a fresh game installation with a clean Mod folder and starting a new game. You can't just merge the modpack with your own mods without cleaning out the duplicates first. Removing some of your own body mods will probably render your old savedata unbootable. Read the errors from the console and try to figure which mods need to be restored. The fix is easy. Post on the support thread if you can't figure it out yourself.

All presets included in this pack are for personal use only. They are not meant to be perfect, but to test different body proportions and face setups and should not be used for public screenshots unless they are edited first. 
All credit goes to the original mod creators.

If you enjoyed using my modpacks so far, please consider supporting me on Patreon. Keep in mind that I won’t ever paywall my work and everything I make is available for free. This is only to motivate me to keep on making these modpacks better >>> patreon.com/inlolzwetrust
